title: Generative Pretrained Hierarchical Transformer for Time Series Forecasting

problem.claim: Improving time series forecasting accuracy remains an active problem addressed through advanced network architectures and self-supervised pretraining.

gap.claim: Existing approaches have limited training-data scale and generalizability, and their one-step generation schema overlooks output-series temporal dependencies while increasing training costs across different horizon lengths.

narrative_sequence.summary: Recent work seeks better time series forecasting accuracy through advanced architectures and self-supervised pretraining.
Existing approaches are described as having two critical drawbacks.
Single-dataset training restricts training scale and limits model generalizability.
One-step generation requires a customized forecasting head, overlooks temporal dependencies in the output series, and increases training costs under varying horizon lengths.
